**Documents UI + layout library + viewport presets landed.** `document ▾` (`ext/Dropdown`) lists every `/data/playground/index.json` entry — new (`mint_slug` → `untitled-2`…, seeded via the same corrected `seed()`) · open (`swap()`, `ext/editor`'s one-function idiom: saver+listener+canvas+selection move together) · delete (`del()`, refuses on the last document) · save selection as layout. `insert ▾` lists `/data/playground/layouts/index.json` and lands a layout id-stripped via the existing `paste()`. Viewport presets `400 · 768 · 1280 · ⤦` set `--pg-viewport` on the centred `.pg-viewport` box (⤦ default). Seeded three hand-written layouts — holy-grail, sidebar, card-wall — per design §7.

**Proved headless, 1280 (full numbers in this file):** New document mints `untitled-2`, `index.json` gains it, canvas swaps to a fresh 3-node seed (root+2 boxes), tree follows. A fresh page reload reopens `untitled-2` — **shipped: `localStorage` (`lew42-pg-last`)**, not the constructor default — same root id. Reopening `untitled` by name id-matches its original root exactly. **Double-insert id-uniqueness:** inserting `holy-grail` under the root twice yields **7 new node ids each time, 0 ids shared between the two inserts**, and all **51** canvas node ids globally unique (`array.length === Set(array).size`). **400-preset wrap:** `.pg-viewport` measures **exactly 400px**; the inserted row's `nav`/`main`/`aside` start fully overlapping (top **1897** / bottom **1987**, all three identical — one row) and after `wrap: "wrap"` land on three separate lines with **zero pairwise Y overlap** — `nav` 1897–1987, `main` 2002–2092, `aside` 2107–2198. Cleanup: probe documents deleted, `index.json` back to `["untitled"]`; a delete-the-last-document attempt right after was correctly refused. Console errors: only the documented one-time 404 per brand-new slug (task 1's own precedent) — zero real errors.

**One bug found while proving:** the hand-written `holy-grail.json` needed `main`'s own `width: "12em"` (not grow-only) — without it, `main`'s tiny shrink-to-fit basis let it share a wrapped line with `nav`, so only `aside` separated and the design's own overlap test came back ambiguous.

**Added-section cleanup:** `untitled.json` reset to the clean seed (`Flex` `label:"page" direction:"column" gap:"1em" padding:"2em"`, two `Box`es) — task 2/3's residue (pasted duplicate Flex, two probe Grids, stray `justify`) is gone. Also corrected `documents.js`'s `seed()` itself from `direction:"row"` to `"column"` to match design §3's own canonical example, so new documents and the reset default now agree.

**Left for later tasks:** `readme.md`/`doc/*`/the 4-width pass (task 5, per design §10's own build order — outside my fence; `readme.md` is now stale on two more fronts: properties since task 2, documents/layouts/presets now). The toolbar row (now 2 dropdowns + 3 button groups + 4 presets) overflows 1280's ~540px canvas column and scrolls horizontally (`overflow-x:auto`, task 3's own established fix) rather than wrapping — not re-litigated here.
